title: About Us
text: Science Olympiad is a national STEM competition where teams of up to 15 students compete in ~23 events spanning biology, chemistry, physics, earth science, and engineering. Central York fields a team each year that competes at the regional level, with the goal of advancing to states.

Your support helps our students compete, experiment, build, and learn at the highest level.
Become a Sponsor

title: Support Us
text:
Why Sponsor Us?
Science Olympiad gives students the opportunity to take science beyond the classroom. Through hands-on experimentation, engineering, research, and competition, our team develops skills that last far beyond tournament day.
Your sponsorship helps provide the materials, equipment, travel, and resources our students need throughout the season.

Your support helps fund

Laboratory supplies and chemicals
Engineering and construction materials
Scientific equipment and instrumentation
Tournament registration and competition expenses
Travel to competitions
Team merchandise and competition materials
Resources for practices and student preparation







ImportantEvery contribution makes a difference



Whether you are a local business, organization, family, or individual, your support directly contributes to opportunities for Central York students.

title: Central York Science Olympiad
text:
What We Do
Each year, CYHS Science Olympiad brings two competing teams to invitationals across Pennsylvania and Maryland, typically attending six or more tournaments per season, with our top team advancing to the Central PA Regional Tournament and, when we qualify, the PA State Tournament. Competing across 23 events spanning science exams, laboratory work, and engineering builds, our 40+ students put months of practice to the test against some of the strongest teams in the state.
